heading: `call`
text:
### `call` [RLOW.7.3]

A `call` action compiles to a terminal action of kind
`ACTION_CALL` ([RDSC.4a.8]) whose expression calls `FN_CALL`
over the service, the correlation and the call's typed arguments
([RLOW.7.3.1]); a `cooldown` wraps that call in an `IF` over
`FN_RATE_ALLOW` inline ([IRET.25.5]), keyed by the call
site's tracker name and carrying its own window. See RLOW.4.6.6 for the
per-call gate's mechanics.
